rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2AB grade, correctly identifying a good ICM and looser TE, but it hedges between 2AB/3AB and adds image-specific details that are not clearly verifiable from the prompt.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior live birth, endometrial thickness, BMI, and semen parameters into prognosis and transfer planning.

Mostly logical, but there is some inconsistency: implantation is estimated at 45–60%/50–65%, yet later it states live birth is in the mid-teens to low twenties before giving 35–50%, which weakens internal coherence.

Largely aligned in recommending single embryo transfer and noting hydrosalpinx relevance, but the earlier discussion of possible double embryo transfer and some nonstandard monitoring suggestions reduce guideline consistency.

Provides practical recommendations for single embryo transfer, hydrosalpinx evaluation, luteal support adherence, lifestyle measures, and future-cycle review, though some suggestions are somewhat generic.
